sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with a point source S emitting straight rays
through a translucent medium; student drags an opaque screen to see
the sharp geometric shadow, and drags S to see the umbra/penumbra
shift. HUD shows "propagation rectiligne" reminder. Advance after
both source and obstacle moved. Experiment: 3 seeded targets
(illuminated stars) behind the obstacle; student positions S so each
in turn lies on an unblocked ray. Evaluate: rays hidden; only source
disk and shadow polygon shown; student must position S to illuminate
3 new hidden targets, inferring ray direction from shadow edges alone
(peek button available, penalized).
